chunks: Bakr ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Musa, al-Asari, claims that he is from the descendants of Ashjj of the Banu Asar who were mentioned to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). He is known by the kunya Abu Muhammad. He narrates strange reports and relies on unknown narrators. And his affair is obscure.

key_terms.أَمْرُهُ مُظْلِمٌ: His affair/status is obscure or unclear
key_terms.يَزْعُمُ: Claims (often implying doubt or lack of verification)

ai.seo_question: Who is Bakr ibn Ahmad al-Asari and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book 'Kitab al-Duafa' describing the narrator Bakr ibn Ahmad al-Asari. It notes his claim of lineage, his reputation for narrating strange reports, his reliance on unknown narrators, and the obscurity of his status.
